description: Ministry of Labor and Trade Union Relations - Notify the collection agreement  entered into betweeen  Sri Ramco Roofings Lanka Pvt. Ltd., and Inter Company Employees Union
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between a private company and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory terms and conditions of employment, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on the legal framework governing labor relations and employment terms, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
